content:
We have created an official vscode extension for Roc to make sure vscode users can have the most up to date experience. Please give it a try before I make a post in announcements. I have only tested it on macos so far.

You may get a warning that the publisher is not verified, I have performed all verification steps I can do on my end, the remaining work needs to be done by someone at Microsoft.

Big thanks to @Luke Boswell whose fork inspired vital components, and to the maintainers of other Roc vscode extensions @Ivan Demchenko, @Benjamin Thomas and @Hannes for their efforts :heart:
This is awesome! Will definitely give it a go!
Oh I just tried it, and it's amazing, thanks a lot!
I tested on windows and it did crash so I will be fixing that probably today
